## About
Turbo Performance does one thing and does it carefully: turbochargers and superchargers. We rebuild them, upgrade them, build custom units to your size and performance needs, and handle assembly and balancing in our own shop.
Our roots are in Los Angeles, and our shop is at 14735 Oxnard St in Van Nuys. Truckers are a big part of who we serve, along with boat owners, industrial customers and people building performance cars. We also ship for customers who are not nearby.
When you bring a turbo in, we take it apart with you so you can see what is wrong before any work starts. Customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 35 Google reviews.

## Services
- Turbo rebuild: Our price to rebuild a turbo. ($880)
- Holset turbocharger rebuilding: We have the specialized tools to rebuild Holset turbochargers to meet or exceed factory specifications.
- Actuator testing: Our test equipment lets us calibrate and test most actuators.
- Supercharger rebuilding: Supercharger rebuilds for vehicles and industrial equipment.
- Marine applications: We work on all marine applications.
- Turbocharger upgrading: Upgrades suited to your specific application.
- Custom turbochargers and superchargers: Units built to your size and performance requirements.

## FAQ
Q: How much does a turbo rebuild cost?
A: Our price to rebuild a turbo is $880.

Q: How long will my big rig turbo take?
A: We keep a large inventory of big rig parts, so 95% of the time a turbo brought in at 9 am is done by 12 noon.

Q: Do you ship outside the area?
A: Yes. We offer international shipping services.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
